fixed_design.interpretation: These mirror implementation constants. Changing this section alone does not reconfigure the algorithms; change code and version together.

protocol.test_policy: test exposed only after freeze, once per run; no sequential cost-to-target estimate
protocol.statistics: all runs reported; paired bootstrap over Monte Carlo seeds, not donors; no confirmatory p-values

scope: frozen before this pilot execution; not an independently registered confirmatory study
